title: New finding based on Comparative Toxicogenomics Database: Hepatic YY1 mediates drug-induced liver injury.
authors: Zhao, Jin-Quan; Sun, Yuan; Yang, Lu-Lu; Long, Jing; Jiang, Yan; Li, Hui-Jun
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肝毒性药物通过YY1转录因子抑制FXR等靶基因表达介导药物性肝损伤，虽涉及YY1-DNA转录调控和分子对接，但核心是毒理学机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，AI/物理模拟方法仅作为辅助验证。
abstract: BACKGROUND: YY1 plays a crucial part in the onset and progression of numerous liver diseases, yet the significant contribution of YY1 to drug-induced liver injury (DILI) appears to have been underestimated by researchers. PURPOSE: To reveal the underlying role of YY1 in DILI. METHOD: The compounds that interact with YY1 were queried in the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD), with the majority found to be hepatotoxic, which includes certain widely used drugs. Molecular docking and SPR characterized the robust binding of hepatotoxic compounds to YY1. The duty of YY1 in DILI was investigated in Diosbulbin B (DIOB), a recently identified hepatotoxic compound that tightly associates with YY1, and further validated on ANIT, LCA, APAP, and CDDP. Transcriptomic analysis disclosed the underlying mechanisms involved in DIOB-induced liver injury. RT-qPCR, immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence, western blotting, and cellular transfection techniques were employed to validate the specific mechanism. RESULTS: Among the 94 compounds affecting YY1 expression in the CTD, 59 compounds exhibited hepatotoxicity, showing close interactions with YY1 and almost consistent binding sites by molecular docking. The SPR validated the tough binding of several hepatotoxic compounds to YY1, including five FDA-approved hepatotoxic drugs. Mechanistically, the involvement of YY1 in DILI was uncovered through the cholestasis lens, mice hepatic YY1 was up-regulated by hepatotoxic DIOB and transcriptionally inhibited FXR and its downstream BSEP and MRP2 expression, initiating early in cholestatic liver injury and persisting to drive the progression of cholestasis. ANIT and LCA-induced model of cholestasis provided evidence for the hypothesis that YY1 frequently mediates drug induced cholestasis (DIC). APAP and CDDP indicated that YY1 may also be involved in hepatocellular and mixed type DILI. CONCLUSION: YY1 widely mediated the development of DIC and also might be engaged in other types of DILI. YY1 presented a common target for hepatotoxic medications and the targeting of liver YY1 for drug development may offer a novel approach for managing DILI.
abstract_zh: 背景：YY1在多种肝脏疾病的发生和发展中扮演关键角色，然而YY1对药物性肝损伤（drug-induced liver injury, DILI）的重要贡献似乎被研究人员低估了。目的：揭示YY1在DILI中的潜在作用。方法：在比较毒物基因组学数据库（Comparative Toxicogenomics Database, CTD）中查询与YY1相互作用的化合物，发现其中大多数具有肝毒性，包括某些广泛使用的药物。分子对接和表面等离子体共振（SPR）表征了肝毒性化合物与YY1的强效结合。在最近发现的与YY1紧密相关的肝毒性化合物Diosbulbin B（DIOB）中研究了YY1在DILI中的作用，并在ANIT、LCA、APAP和CDDP上进一步验证。转录组分析揭示了DIOB诱导肝损伤所涉及的潜在机制。采用RT-qPCR、免疫组织化学、免疫荧光、蛋白质印迹和细胞转染技术验证具体机制。结果：在CTD中影响YY1表达的94种化合物中，59种表现出肝毒性，与YY1有密切相互作用，且分子对接显示结合位点几乎一致。SPR验证了多种肝毒性化合物与YY1的强效结合，包括五种FDA批准的肝毒性药物。机制上，通过胆汁淤积视角揭示了YY1在DILI中的参与，小鼠肝脏YY1被肝毒性DIOB上调，并在转录水平抑制FXR及其下游BSEP和MRP2表达，在胆汁淤积性肝损伤早期启动并持续驱动胆汁淤积进展。ANIT和LCA诱导的胆汁淤积模型为YY1频繁介导药物性胆汁淤积（drug-induced cholestasis, DIC）的假设提供了证据。APAP和CDDP表明YY1也可能参与肝细胞型和混合型DILI。结论：YY1广泛介导DIC的发展，并可能参与其他类型的DILI。YY1是肝毒性药物的常见靶点，靶向肝脏YY1进行药物开发可能为管理DILI提供新方法。
